# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.

# residual correction test
Calculate a set of two test residual corrections. Modify the binning of the track pt dimension of the histograms filled during the track residual correction calculation such that all bins stay the same except the last bin ranges to 15 GeV instead of whatever the current setting is. Keep the log binning up to that last binning. Calculate a "test" track correction for the nominal pp case (using pp MC), and for the muon-track systematic variation where we require isMuTagged=false. Calculate also a "test" set of energy extrapolations (data-driven) using for pp using these two track residuals. Do not override current correction files and do not change the path in the dictionary. These are not official corrections. Remake the muon-track standalone systematic plots for the inclusive AND scan kinematic selections with the test correction (nominal compared to variation) and save them to the default plots/ directory in the Systematics working directory. Do not copy to the overleaf, point the user to the paths of these plots.


# conclusion
Make the minimum number of edits necessary to implement functionality. Do not add superflous error statement catches or checks. 

Have the subanalyzer handoff a summary to you and you should review that summary for flaws. Update copilot instructions on the new norms detailed here and learned by you or the subanalyzer throught these tasks.
